fields.topology_type: Tiered star, host-centric; 1 host controller + up to 5 hub tiers + up to 127 devices (including hubs themselves).

supported_topologies.name: Single root hub + N devices
supported_topologies.description: Host's root hub connects directly to functions.

supported_topologies.name: Multi-tier hub cascade
supported_topologies.description: Up to 5 additional tiers of external hubs cascaded from the root hub.

supported_topologies.name: Compound device
supported_topologies.description: A single physical device implements both a hub and one or more functions internally.

supported_topologies.name: Self-powered hub
supported_topologies.description: Hub has its own VBUS source; supports more 500-mA-class downstream devices.

supported_topologies.name: Bus-powered hub
supported_topologies.description: Hub draws all power from upstream VBUS; downstream devices restricted to ≤ 100 mA each.

master_slave_role_summary.description: One per bus; initiates all transactions; assigns addresses; manages enumeration + suspend/resume.
Tier-1 hub built into the host; controls VBUS + reset for its downstream ports.
Tier 2..6; cascades the bus + provides additional downstream ports; USB 2.0 hub also implements Transaction Translator for HS→FS/LS bridging.
Endpoint device (keyboard, MSC, camera, etc.); a function is a USB device that provides a capability to the host.
Hub + function(s) in one physical package; appears as multiple devices to the host.

fields.interconnect_role: The bus is host-controlled. Hubs forward packets transparently (FS↔FS, LS↔LS); USB 2.0 hubs additionally bridge HS↔FS/LS via Transaction Translators using Split transactions.

ordering_guarantees.per_endpoint_data_toggle: Successful transactions on an endpoint observe strict ordering — receiver only accepts the expected toggle, retransmits on mismatch.
ordering_guarantees.frame_boundary: All periodic (Interrupt + Isochronous) transactions complete within their (micro)frame budget.
ordering_guarantees.host_scheduling: Host decides the order of transactions in each (micro)frame; no native fairness between devices.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: Not applicable — USB is wire-level + framework. Host-side Host Controller register maps are in separate specs (OHCI / UHCI / EHCI / xHCI).

device_classification.function: Capability-providing device (HID, MSC, Audio, Video, CDC, Printer, etc.).
device_classification.hub: Bus-forwarding device adding more downstream ports.
device_classification.compound_device: Hub + function(s) in one physical package.
device_classification.self_powered_device: Power from local source; ≤ 100 mA from VBUS for enumeration only.
device_classification.bus_powered_device: All power from VBUS; ≤ 100 mA pre-config / ≤ 500 mA configured.
